direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 52px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; cols 184px rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; guide strip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Inspector evidence list has a nested double focus ring and clipped scroll edge; refit to one 2px neon focus ring and 8px scroll padding so both source records stay fully visible at 1366x768.
Enlarge SVG job and option labels below 11px to 11px minimum; tighten the opening-story hero height so the 120 versus 80 tracks and DOES NOT MATCH marker keep clear separation.
Add bidirectional highlighting between MAT-ALLOY-A, the quantity tracks, and ev-cert-qty / ev-recv-qty rows, announced via aria-live polite.
Keep Route health pre-flight for nonce and identity as its own headed section and Investigation source evidence as a distinct task; do not merge their status text or controls.
Enlarge the offline route-health status to 13px and pair the Sample select with a 36px target and visible focus ring; state that no network request occurred beside the control.
On SVG focus, highlight only feasible option chips and keep HOLD on MAT-ALLOY-A; add keyboard order from route select to Run Sample investigation.
Preserve the typed consent form opening on option selection; keep Accept disabled until the exact APPROVE allocate_substitute phrase matches, with 0/27 typed retained as text, not color alone.
Align the three option cards to a shared metric baseline so 83h, 35h and 17.5h compare instantly; enlarge finish and incremental micro-labels to 11px.
Give each Select this path control a radio role, arrow-key movement and a clear selected marker plus text.
Inspector task list clips t3 at the fold; refit panel spacing and allow internal scroll with a visible end marker so all 3 proposed tasks are reachable without page scroll.
Retain PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL on every proposal and in the action-bar centre; do not show tracking state before human approval.
Remove the duplicate primary emphasis between the in-panel Approve control and the action-bar Approve Britt's proposal; keep one neon primary per viewport.
The preview state for CELL-MILL-2 must not yet use stoppedRed; reserve red for the applied offline state in step 6 and use silver dashed PREVIEW - WILL GO OFFLINE here.
Enlarge the consequence line Will invalidate acceptance for Use verified substitute to 13px and place it directly under the machine select with a 36px select target.
Add Esc to clear the preview back to the accepted plan and announce the preview change once via aria-live polite.

Preserve stoppedRed exclusively on CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; verify no feasible route traces through that cell and the Split option reads CONSTRAINED with hatch plus text.
Keep pre-flight nonce and identity route health separate from the reinvestigation evidence task, with the new 3 to 2 feasible paths banner linked to both sections.
Enlarge the constrained chip and event-chain labels to 11px minimum; keep the single 240ms route trace on state change, then static.
Keep prior acceptance invalidated status in the action bar until the typed revised phrase matches exactly; retain the disabled Accept revised decision with its reason as text.
Make the constrained Split card non-selectable with hatch, x marker and reason text, while the two feasible cards keep radio behaviour and 36px targets.
Align revised tradeoff metrics and plan identifier on one baseline to reduce scanning between inspector and SVG chips.

Show 3 BLOCKED prior tasks and 3 PROPOSED replacements as two labelled groups that coexist with the approved revised plan; replacements stay untracked until approval and never replace the blocked group visually.
Refit the inspector scroll region so the first proposed task is not cut mid-line; add top and bottom fade plus a scroll end indicator within 360px width.
Keep one neon primary, Approve revised tasks, in the action bar; demote the in-panel Approve control to secondary outline.

Order the proof flow as three numbered, gated controls: Verify ledger, then separate export passphrase of 16-160 characters, then Export independent checkpoint; show waiting reasons as text at each gate.
Label the Before to After metrics 70, 35h and 48h with units and captions at 11px minimum so the proven gain reads without narration.
Ensure the action-bar Verify ledger is the sole primary until verification completes, then move neon emphasis to the next gated control and announce it politely.
Retain PACKET SEALED summary with 18 events, revised plan accepted and CELL-MILL-2 offline retained in the action bar; keep red only on the stopped station.
Mark the rail item Recovery story complete with aria-current and a check plus text, not color alone; keep all prior steps reachable by arrow keys for review.
Add a compact retained-evidence summary beside Verify, Seal and Checkpoint completion so the sealed outcome is inspectable without reopening prior steps.
